meta.title: xopc — A Self-hosted Personal AI Runtime
meta.description: Run AI on your hardware. Connect models, agents, sessions, projects, goals, notes, workflows, and automations across terminal, web, desktop, mobile, and messengers.
meta.ogDescription: xopc is a self-hosted, local-first personal AI runtime. Own your data, keys, and environment while long-running work stays resumable, executable, and triggerable.

hero.desc: A self-hosted, local-first personal AI runtime connecting models, agents, durable state, workflows, automations, and every surface you use. You own the data, keys, and environment.

download.hackableComment: # Source install — for contributors and deep customization
download.hackablePnpmInstallCommand: cd xopc && corepack enable && pnpm install
download.hackablePnpmComment2: # Run from source; build then onboard
download.hackablePnpmOnboardCommand: pnpm run build && pnpm exec xopc onboard
download.title: Up and running in 30 seconds.
download.subtitle: One command installs Node.js and xopc, then walks you through onboarding — macOS, Linux, or Windows.
download.quickInstallComment: # One command — macOS, Linux, and Windows.
download.quickInstallFootnote: Works on macOS, Linux, and Windows. The one-liner installs Node.js and everything else for you. Hackable clones from git for local hacking. Switch tabs for npm or desktop downloads.
download.advancedSubtitle: If you already have Node.js 22+ and prefer the package manager route.
download.npmBody: Node.js 22+ required. pnpm is also supported: pnpm add -g @xopcai/xopc. China mirror: npm install -g @xopcai/xopc --registry=https://registry.npmmirror.com. Then chat: xopc tui --local
download.npmOnboardBody: Interactive onboarding — pick your model and add API keys. Faster path: xopc onboard --quick
download.desktopSubtitle: Download Electron builds for macOS, Windows, or Linux from GitHub Releases.

features.desc: xopc puts models, agents, durable state, and execution into an environment you control instead of piling features into another chat window.

items.title: Bring your own API keys. Choose any model.
items.body: DeepSeek, OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Ollama, LM Studio, vLLM, Bedrock, Azure, and 20+ providers are built in. Run fully local inference or mix cloud and local models; switch with one config line and avoid vendor lock-in.

items.title: Durable state, not one context window.
items.body: Sessions, projects, goals, notes, workspaces, and run history have explicit ownership. Resume long-running work without reconstructing it every time.

items.title: Projects, Goals, and Notes have distinct jobs.
items.body: Projects group context, Goals track status, blockers, and next actions, while Notes capture text, voice, images, and attachments wherever input happens.

items.title: Observable workflows. Traceable automations.
items.body: Organize complex execution into phases and subagents, then trigger it on schedules, manually, or from webhooks. Progress, results, failures, and retries stay visible.

items.title: Agent capability boundaries are explicit.
items.body: Give each agent its own identity, responsibilities, model roles, workspace, tool policy, skills, memory, and boundaries.

items.title: Add capabilities only when needed.
items.body: Skills provide task methods, Extensions add tools, channels, and UI, and Connectors bring in external capabilities while the core stays clear.

items.title: Your machine. Your rules.
items.body: xopc runs on your hardware. Conversations, project context, and local state stay in your xopc runtime. API keys stay in your config. No mandatory cloud. No surprise bills.

cta.desc: MIT open source and local-first. Start with one model and agent, then add projects, goals, notes, workflows, and automations when the work becomes durable.

loop.titleLine2: Work that has a next step.
loop.desc: xopc separates long-running work into explicit state, execution, triggers, and access. It does not assume AI remembers everything; important information has a home, complex execution is observable, and follow-up can start again.

steps.title: Durable state
steps.body: Sessions, Projects, Goals, Notes, and Workspaces retain conversations, progress, source material, and artifacts.

steps.title: Explicit execution
steps.body: Agents use allowed tools and skills; Workflows organize multi-step or parallel work into inspectable runs.

steps.title: Active triggers
steps.body: Automations run agents or workflows on schedules, manually, or from webhooks, with visible success, failure, and retry history.

steps.title: Access anywhere
steps.body: Terminal, web, desktop, mobile, messengers, and HTTP/SSE APIs connect to the same runtime and state.
